name: Glowing Soul Gem
summary: A Glowing Soul Gem is a dark ritual artifact carried by operatives of the Cult of the Dark Strand in northern Ashenvale. Imbued with shadowy sorcery, the stone traps the spirit of an unwitting victim to fuel the cult's sinister operations.

sections.title: A Vessel of Dark Sorcery
sections.body: Northeast of Maestra's Post, in the shadowed ruins of Ordil'Aran, members of the Cult of the Dark Strand wield dark sorcery under the watchful eyes of their shadowy masters. Among their ranks, operatives carry Glowing Soul Gems—vessels enchanted to trap and torment the souls of the dead. Rather than mere decorative trinkets, these stones act as conduits of magical energy, anchoring bound spirits to serve the cult's shadowy ends.

sections.title: The Secrets of Ordil'Aran
sections.body: Seeking to dismantle the Dark Strand's influence across northern Kalimdor, Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post investigates these artifacts. Deciphering the enchantments woven into a Glowing Soul Gem reveals not just dark arcane formulas, but an imprisoned soul crying out from within the gem, exposing the sinister experiments linking the cultists in Ashenvale to their kin at the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: What is the Glowing Soul Gem?
faq.answer: It is an enchanted soulstone used by the Cult of the Dark Strand. Imbued with shadow magic, it traps spirits inside to harness their essence and fuel the cult's foul sorcery.

faq.q: Where does this soul gem come from?
faq.answer: It is carried by members of the Cult of the Dark Strand—including their cultists, assassins, enforcers, and adepts—operating out of the ruins of Ordil'Aran in northern Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who wants this soul gem and why?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier, stationed at Maestra's Post, seeks the gem. He believes deciphering its enchantments will uncover the secret source of the cult's power and reveal what they are plotting.

faq.q: What happens when the soul gem is deciphered?
faq.answer: Unraveling the enchantments on the gem releases the ghost trapped within it, freeing the tormented soul and exposing the twisted depths of the Dark Strand's practices.

angles.text: Warlocks understand the art of trapping spirits within soulstones better than anyone, recognizing the Dark Strand's gem as a cruder, necromantic derivative of soul manipulation.
Priests viewing the soul gem can sense the agony of the spirit imprisoned within, recognizing the urgent need to cleanse the artifact and release the soul to peace.
